description: 1 double bedroom, 1 single bedroom, 1 full bathroom, 1 WC, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Single-aspect apartment, windows on left facade. Kitchen at top-left corner of open plan space, L-shaped wall counter. Kitchen adjacent to the facade wall, well-lit cooking position. Cook faces the corner wall, back to dining and living. Living arrangement: L-shaped, kitchen in top-left corner, dining left-center, seating area bottom-left. Dining table visible, approximately 6 seats. No TV clearly visible. Bathroom config: 1 full bathroom; 1 WC-only room. Parallel morning routines possible. Both bedrooms on right side accessed from corridor. No en-suite. Single bedroom large enough for bunk bed. Possible configurations: (1) children's bedroom; (2) home office or hobby room; (3) guest room; (4) bunk bed. Storage room adjacent to kitchen zone, usable as kitchen pantry, laundry or general storage. Entry from right. Door separates entry corridor from living area. Suits couples needing a spare room, people working from home.
not_suitable_for: families with two or more children
